subject: Let shinyapps.io run shiny app daily automatically

messages.author: 50022cda6ea73757
messages.subject: Let shinyapps.io run shiny app daily automatically
parts:
Hi:

I uploaded an app to my shinyapps.io account, and I want to let it run daily automatically. I added 
invalidateLater(86400000)
and it works locally (after the app becomes idle for a while, it automatically runs again), but when uploaded to shinyapps.io, it doesn't work. I close the app, and wait for a day, and it wasn't ran automatically. I checked the log file and it confirmed that the app did not run.

Is there any way to let the shiny app run on shinyapps.io automatically without leaving the app open in the browser?

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Let shinyapps.io run shiny app daily automatically
parts: shinyapps.io is meant for interactive applications or dashboards. When there are no active browser sessions, an application will go to sleep. See the documentation on the application life cycle.
